findings.evidence: src/core/admin.rs::copy_tree had cfg(unix) around file sync, explicitly excluding Windows.
findings.classification: Source-verified missing flush; not an observed hardware power-loss incident.

findings.evidence: src/core/format/upgrade.rs copied retained files and top-level data-directory files without flushing their contents before publication.

mechanism: One crate-private copy_file_synced helper retains native fs::copy, including native Windows metadata/alternate streams. Windows opens a writable flush handle after temporarily clearing the unpublished copy read-only bit when necessary, restoring it before propagating errors. Upgrade publication syncs directory entries where supported.
coverage: Read-only nested file contents and permissions preserved, process lock excluded.
Mixed-version multi-tenant upgrade preserves read-only deployment metadata and current tenant arena.
Existing schema/checkpoint/source-byte preservation, audit-history upgrade and corruption checks pass.
limits: Tests verify contents, permissions and workflows; they do not simulate hardware power loss.
No claim that the added data-preservation cases fail on the baseline: the missing sync was established by source inspection.
Windows directory sync remains a no-op; no complete power-loss or filesystem-independent durability guarantee.
integration_gate: Pending PR and up-to-date main integration.

native_copy_refinement.reason: The initial unmerged stream-copy implementation would omit NTFS alternate streams preserved by native copying.
native_copy_refinement.tests: Windows-only alternate-stream assertions added to nested migration copies and top-level multi-tenant upgrade metadata. Their runtime verification awaits Windows CI.
